name: StackCostMatrix B2B SaaS Integration Cost Index
notes: Plan prices are monthly-billing list prices in USD where the vendor publishes one; annual_billing_per_seat_usd_per_month is the vendor's annual-billing price, where published.

Middleware and connector fees follow the same rule: middleware_monthly_usd is the monthly-billing price and middleware_annual_billing_usd_per_month the annual-billing price (Make Core's monthly price comes from third-party pricing reviews because make.com blocks automated checks).
Free tiers are listed where the vendor documents the integration working on its free plan.

Modeled assumptions: HubSpot Professional and Enterprise are flat monthly prices; ActiveCampaign and Pipedrive list annual-billing rates only; Salesforce and QuickBooks Online prices were last verified 2026-10-17.
Each pair's 'verification' field states what was checked and when, including exceptions.
